in_sanskrit.name: Ashmay
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ash - immortal, May - illusion
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ashmay एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Ashmay is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ash’ meaning immortal and ‘May’ meaning illusion. This name is associated with the idea of eternal consciousness, beyond the illusion of physical existence.
